runtime_versions.omlx_identity_note: Official wheel; no proven VCS commit. Installed files are pinned. The separate source checkout is not the wheel identity.

C1_selection_plan.scope: After the running C1..64 sweep completes, rerun C1 with native, oMLX balanced, oMLX aggressive, and Lithos in three fresh, reversed-order rounds. No source optimization changes during this comparison.
C1_selection_plan.publication_rule: Use this larger preplanned four-configuration experiment for all final C1 comparisons; use the original sweep for C2..64. Retain every original C1 point as a separate earlier experiment. This replacement rule is set before any aggressive-mode result exists.
C1_selection_plan.why: Official settings.py exposes aggressive as a single-request budget option; concurrent burst budget is unchanged. Test its low-concurrency endpoint rather than assuming balanced is the strongest C1 baseline.

capped_C64_plan.hypothesis: The C64 native point is dominated by the measured C32 point. Keep64 HTTP requests, cap active sequences at32, preserve queueing and count all64 completions. Test three fresh native processes.
capped_C64_plan.comparison: Retain the existing uncapped C64 native and oMLX measurements; add the cap32 configuration as a distinct measured point. Official C64 processes are reused from the immediately preceding sweep, not claimed to be paired with cap32. Report TTFT as well as both Pareto axes.
capped_C64_plan.publication: Retain all three runs regardless of outcome. Do not replace the uncapped C64 records or infer a cap32 win without measurements.

qualification.domain: M5 Ultra MLX0.32.3 27B BF16 NVFP4, fusion B1..8 length<=256; other cases eager

graph_only_qualification.scope: All B1..8, last optimized length and first eager length; compile enabled, fusion disabled.

free_generation.scope: Raw IDs match eager at the same batch/schedule, greedy normal EOS; batch sizes are not assumed numerically equivalent.

scope: M5 Ultra 256 GiB; fixed Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4; 19 input/32 output; greedy normal EOS; no prompt cache/draft; 3 fresh processes x 3 measured groups; warm steady-state; C is HTTP concurrency
limits: Only the sampled concurrency values and this short workload; not an entire continuous curve or universal workload claim
C1 uses the preplanned later four-configuration comparison, including oMLX aggressive; the earlier C1 experiment is fully retained separately
oMLX uses balanced at C2..64; aggressive changes the single-request burst budget only, while the concurrent budget remains 0.03 seconds
C64/B32 is a separately measured configuration: all64 HTTP requests complete, at most32 active sequences. Its three native processes are not paired with the earlier official C64 processes
Lithos official endpoint supports only C1; this is one measured point, with a local M5 Ultra profile
x is a client text-delivery estimate, not raw GPU generation speed; y includes prefill and HTTP delivery
Three process ranges are observations, not confidence intervals
B1..8 fusion is opt-in and used length <=256; larger batches/contexts stay eager
Three warm groups precede measurement; all measured time is retained, including any compilation for a previously unseen batch shape
Static batch output identities need not equal mixed-arrival HTTP output identities; both same-batch free generation and changing-row scheduler states are separately qualified
Batched-retirement measurements at C8/32/64 use a separately hashed implementation; original sweep baselines are unpaired and retained. No arithmetic changes.

retirement_qualification.scope: Same outputs and surviving cache bytes after every engine step; simultaneous and staggered retirement.

retirement_plan.hypothesis: Retire all finished rows once per scheduler step. Avoid O(B^2) successive cache compactions at request completion. No change to scheduling, token production, model arithmetic or per-request stop rules.
retirement_plan.qualification: Raw generation and complete surviving cache signatures after each step, B2/8/32/64 simultaneous and B8 staggered completion plus insertion/stop. CPU lifecycle checks.
retirement_plan.measurement: After correctness and the currently planned base comparisons, measure C8, C32 and C64 in three fresh native processes each, max active sequences = HTTP concurrency. Reuse the earlier base sweep as an unpaired reference; keep all results regardless of outcome. Same 19 input and32 output workload, three warm and three measured groups.
retirement_plan.adoption: Adopt only after exact lifecycle and generation checks, and evidence of a useful end-to-end improvement. Preserve both implementation versions in artifacts.

retirement_step_diagnostic.scope: Descriptive filter of all warm and measured C64 steps:37 tokens delivered,11 active/pending after step. Not a paired microbenchmark; all raw steps retained.
